llms:
Formula x_0 is the output pixel centre; x_s for s = 1..L follows the normalised field forward and for s = -1..-L backward, each step an RK2 midpoint step of stepLength output pixels along sign * v / |v|, with v bilinearly sampled from the field. A direction stops early at the field or output edge, NaN data, or speed zero or below minimumSpeed; only visited pixels join both sums. The noise N is white noise per output pixel, Philox keyed (seed, column, row). With period > 0 the window is multiplied by 0.5 * (1 + cos(2 pi (s / period - phase))); this run is static (period 0). A pixel whose centre has no field data is NaN. Direction is taken in the field space, so a lon/lat field with a lon/lat output step follows streamlines in degrees.
